content:
**Tunnel of Love** is an unmarked location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Nuka-World on Tour* update.

The Tunnel of Love was set up inside an abandoned mining shaft. Alongside the various Nuka-World on Tour memorabilia and decor, abandoned mining equipment can be found inside. It's inhabited by Mole Miners, Mole Rats, as well as two Legendary Deathclaws that can all be encountered during the associated event.

The public Event: Tunnel Of Love takes place here, where players collaborate with Mr. Lovely to fix up the ride.

Tunnel of Love appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Nuka-World on Tour* update.
